# Nhimbe - African Events Platform

> Together we gather, together we grow

Nhimbe (pronounced /ˈnhimbɛ/) is a community events discovery and management platform connecting communities across Africa. The name comes from the Shona tradition of communal work, embodying the Ubuntu philosophy: "I am because we are."

## About

Nhimbe is part of the Mukoko ecosystem, developed by Nyuchi Web Services. We help people discover events, connect with communities, and celebrate together across African cities including:

- Harare, Zimbabwe
- Bulawayo, Zimbabwe
- Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe
- Johannesburg, South Africa
- Cape Town, South Africa
- Nairobi, Kenya
- Lagos, Nigeria
- Accra, Ghana

## Features

- **Event Discovery**: Browse events by category, city, or search
- **Event Creation**: Host your own gatherings with AI-powered description assistance (Shamwari)
- **RSVP & Registration**: Easy event registration, waitlists, and ticketing
- **Calendars**: Follow curated event streams (`/calendars/<slug>`, with an ICS feed)
- **Circles**: Community groups that host events together
- **Calendar Integration**: Add events to your calendar via ICS export
- **QR Code Sharing**: Share events easily with short URLs (`/e/<code>`)
- **Maps**: View venues on OpenStreetMap (Leaflet), no API key required
- **Weather**: Forecasts for event locations via the shared Mukoko weather embed

## Event Categories

- Tech
- Culture
- Wellness
- Social
- Professional
- Music
- Food & Drink
- Sports
- Community
- Education

## AI Features

Nhimbe includes an AI assistant called **Shamwari** (meaning "friend" in Shona) that helps event hosts create compelling descriptions through a guided wizard, and powers semantic event search.

## Public API

Nhimbe exposes a same-origin read API for event discovery (JSON):

- `GET /api/events` - List published events
- `GET /api/events/:id` - Get event details
- `GET /api/categories` - List event categories
- `GET /api/cities` - List available cities
- `GET /api/community/stats` - Community statistics

Writes (`POST /api/events`, `PATCH /api/events/:id`) require a WorkOS bearer token — see the agent authentication guide below.

## For AI Agents

- **Agent auth guide**: https://nhimbe.com/auth.md (how to authenticate with WorkOS AuthKit bearer tokens)
- **OAuth authorization server metadata**: https://nhimbe.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- **OAuth protected resource metadata**: https://nhimbe.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- **OpenID configuration**: https://nhimbe.com/.well-known/openid-configuration
- **MCP server** (task-based, Streamable HTTP): https://events.mukoko.com/mcp — tools: `events_near_me`, `events_matching_interests`, `get_event` (anonymous reads); `create_event`, `update_event` (bearer-authed writes)
